hour1_gemini_enterprise.title: Hour 1: Gemini Enterprise (Sobi / Spark, Agent Platform, Registry & GECX)
hour1_gemini_enterprise.presenters: Luis Lopez, Sundar Chellappa, Ricky Merrefield & Jesus Chavez

slides.title: 1. The Sea Change: From Passive Chat to Software-Generating Teammates
slides.subtitle: Gemini Enterprise (`global-gemini-enterprise`) & Spark (`sobi-<USER_ID>`)
bullets: One Unified Prompt Box across Web (`gemini.google.com/work`), Desktop, Mobile, and Microsoft Teams/Outlook.
Spark is a persistent digital teammate that writes and runs Python/Bash inside isolated gVisor sandboxes to build dashboards, audit TRID disclosures, and analyze Redfin MLS spreadsheets.
Model Choice Built-In: Run workloads on Gemini 4 Argon (`gemini-4-argon`), Gemini 3.8 Flash, or Claude Opus/Sonnet 5.5 under a single Google Cloud enterprise contract and security perimeter.

slides.title: 2. Query-in-Place Enterprise Grounding & 3-Object Agent Registry
slides.subtitle: Connecting O365 SharePoint, OneDrive, Encompass LOS, and BigQuery without Data Replication
bullets: Zero 'Storage Double Taxation': Query Rocket's SharePoint Online, Fannie/Freddie Selling Guides, and BigQuery Redfin/Mr. Cooper tables in-place.
RFC 530 3-Object Connector Architecture: `McpServer` (`agentregistry-<UUID>`), `AuthProvider` (`ge-auth-<FP64>`), and `AuthBinding` (`ge-bind-<FP64>`) preserve end-user 3LO Entra ID / O365 ACLs.
Centralized Governance: App Hub & Agent Registry (`ge-ai-app-*`) give Rocket Security a single pane of glass over every agent, tool, and MCP server.

slides.title: 3. Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (GEAP) & Visual Agent Studio
slides.subtitle: Low-Code Underwriting Workflows + Code-First ADK Multi-Agent Orchestration
bullets: Visual Agent Studio (L200) lets Rocket Operations build condition-clearing agents with `RUNTIME_STAGE_BLOCKING` CEL Human-in-the-Loop approval gates.
Agent Development Kit (ADK L300) orchestrates stateful multi-agent teams across Rocket Money, Redfin, and Mr. Cooper Servicing.
Model Armor + Cloud Sensitive Data Protection (SDP) enforces GLBA ethical walls, masking SSNs and bank account numbers inline.

slides.title: 4. Gemini Enterprise for CX (GECX) & Multimodal Live API (The Sierra AI Killer)
slides.subtitle: Transforming Mr. Cooper Servicing, Escrow Shortages, Synopsis & Portfolio Recapture
bullets: Omnichannel GECX + Dialogflow CX handles high-volume Mr. Cooper escrow shortage journeys, official per-diem payoff quotes, and Form 1098 delivery.
CCAI Agent Assist upgrades Rocket Logic Synopsis from post-call batch summaries into real-time CFPB Regulation X loss-mitigation coaching.
Gemini Multimodal Live API delivers <200ms interruptible bidirectional voice for Refi Recapture—eliminating Sierra AI per-resolution fees.

hour2_antigravity.title: Hour 2: Google Antigravity 2.0, Sandboxed Code Execution, MCP & Gemini 4 Argon
hour2_antigravity.duration: 60 Minutes • Hands-On Builder & SDLC Deep Dive
hour2_antigravity.presenters: Jesus Chavez, Joris Wynendaele & Google CE Mentors

slides.title: 1. Meet Google Antigravity 2.0: The Agent-First Development Platform
slides.subtitle: Why Antigravity + Gemini 4 Argon Leaves Single-Threaded Claude Code Behind
bullets: Antigravity 2.0 Desktop IDE + `agy` CLI + Managed Agents API inside Gemini Enterprise.
Persistent Cloud Execution: Delegate an objective (Goal Mode), close your laptop, and let Antigravity subagents code, run browser tests, and verify builds in isolated gVisor sandboxes.
Powered by Gemini 4 Argon (`gemini-4-argon`) & Gemini 3.8 Flash: 2M context window, Context Caching, and OneQuota enterprise scale.

slides.title: 2. Model Context Protocol (MCP) & Cross-Funnel Subagent Orchestration
slides.subtitle: Unifying Rocket Money -> Redfin -> Rocket Mortgage -> Rocket Close via MCP
bullets: Standardized MCP Servers expose Redfin Tour Webhooks, Rocket Money Goal Vaults, O365 Banker Calendars, and Rocket Pricing Engines safely.
Dynamic Python Workflows (`run_workflow` with `parallel()` and `pipeline()`) fan out across multiple subagents with strict JSON schema contracts.
Live Walkthrough: Building the Redfin-to-Rocket Cross-Funnel Campaign Bot (`4.5`) in 15 lines of Antigravity workflow code.

slides.title: 3. DeepMind CodeMender & The Autonomous AI Software Factory
slides.subtitle: Zero-Touch Vulnerability Patching (`cm verify` / `cm fix`) & Legacy .NET Modernization
bullets: CodeMender traces OWASP CWE-89 SQLi and CWE-639 IDOR vulnerabilities across Rocket LOS APIs, reproduces exploits in a gVisor sandbox, and commits verified patches.
AI Software Factory Swarm (`workspace='share'`) converts a Product Requirements Document (PRD) into a tested FastAPI/.NET 9 Pull Request automatically.
Legacy C#/.NET Framework 4.8 WCF SOAP services refactored into containerized Cloud Run microservices in seconds.

slides.title: 4. Google CE Moonshots & Hackathon Kickoff Blueprint
slides.subtitle: Project Siren, Spatial Close (3D Maps + Imagen 3), HiveMind Swarm & Air-Tight
bullets: How to clone any of the 33 live Cloud Run reference architectures using the Reproduction Blueprints on this portal.
Accessing your GCP Sandbox Project, Vertex AI `gemini-4-argon` & `gemini-3.8-flash` endpoints, and Antigravity MCP starter kits.
Judging Rubric for Track 1 (CX), Track 2 (Ops/Underwriting), Track 3 (Mr. Cooper Servicing), and Track 4 (Wildcard Moonshots).
